title: Navier-Stokes – Tristan Buckmaster [pdf]
why_read: A lecture/paper on the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem by a mathematician who works on fluid singularities, of real interest to anyone following core open problems in PDE theory.
analysis: This is a technical presentation on the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, one of the seven unsolved Clay Institute problems worth a million dollars. Tristan Buckmaster is a mathematician known for constructing non-uniqueness results for weak solutions of Euler and Navier-Stokes equations. The high engagement suggests this touches on recent progress or a survey of the state of the art, which is a genuinely hard and consequential open question in mathematics and fluid mechanics. Worth reading for anyone with a math or physics background interested in why this problem has resisted proof for decades.
